name: model__prediction__grippeweb__baseline-nullmodel
description: Zero-model (null model) forecast for GrippeWeb disease reports. Predicts the next N weeks by averaging the last M reference weeks per disease. Serves as a baseline for comparison with more complex forecast models.

horizon_weeks.description: Number of weeks to forecast ahead.

n_reference_weeks.description: Number of past weeks to average as the baseline prediction.

episerve:inputs.description: The GrippeWeb weekly report table. Only the rows for Region 'Bundesweit' and Altersgruppe '15-34' are used.

episerve:outputs.description: One row per disease and forecast week.

columns.name: Inzidenz
columns.description: Mean of the last n_reference_weeks weeks.

episerve:documentation.method: For each disease, the forecast for every future week is the mean incidence of the last n_reference_weeks weeks.
episerve:documentation.intendedUse: Baseline that other GrippeWeb forecast models should beat.
episerve:documentation.limitations: Fixed to the national series of the 15-34 age group; ignores seasonality and trends.

additionalProperty.name: horizon_weeks
additionalProperty.description: Number of weeks to forecast ahead.

additionalProperty.name: n_reference_weeks
additionalProperty.description: Number of past weeks to average as the baseline prediction.
